releases.body:
- Updated the `mrscraper` skill for the hosted server's three scopes: `scraperAPI` needs `scrape:write`, `webSearch` needs `scrape:read`, and `status` needs `account:read`. If `scraperAPI` returns 403 `insufficient_scope`, run `opencode mcp auth mrscraper` again so OpenCode requests `scrape:write`. Skills are identical to the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.2.2.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.3.1` (shasum `0077cc1e7c9a4b6b18b59febbf091b0cd8c6416a`).

- Updated the skills for the hosted MCP server's new tools: `scraperAPI` (pages as HTML, Markdown, or screenshots), `webSearch` (Google), and `status` (account usage). The `fetch`, `scrape`, `serp`, `rerun`, `results`, and `result` tools no longer exist.
- Removed the `mrscraper-scrape` skill. Skills are identical to the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.2.0.

npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.3.0` (shasum `69212add273b7b170d18c5281d9e842c69e07819`).

- Added OpenCode 2 support. OpenCode 2 does not run OpenCode 1 plugins; the
  package now default-exports one object with an OpenCode 2 `setup()`, which
  registers the `mrscraper` MCP server and the four skills through MCP and
  skill transforms, and an OpenCode 1 `server()`, which keeps the existing
  config hook.
- OpenCode 1 now needs 1.18.29 or later (the first release that loads the
  object form). On older releases, pin `@mrscraper/opencode@0.1.0`.
- The `MrScraperPlugin` named export was removed; use the default export.
- Documented OpenCode 2 install, sign-in, API-key configuration
  (`mcp.servers`), and update commands.


npm: `@mrscraper/opencode@0.2.0` (shasum `a2842c46b21f6cc59fcfd7b52f12ba0b7f1ed15d`).

- Added the initial `@mrscraper/opencode` plugin: registers the hosted
  MrScraper MCP server (`https://mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp`, OAuth 2.1) as
  `mrscraper` unless the user already defines that server, and loads the
  `mrscraper`, `mrscraper-fetch`, `mrscraper-scrape`, and `mrscraper-serp`
  skills from the MrScraper Claude plugin 0.1.4.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mrscraper/opencode
